interpretation: MC estimates the current-policy action-value gradient for a fixed query action; it is a finite-sample reference, not an exact oracle. The target Critic is an EMA estimate and is not automatically the same object as Q^pi_current.
endpoint_generation: same fixed state, z, and Flow-noise batch at each snapshot
critic_source: saved learned-N checkpoint online critic and EMA target critic
reference_source: two independent current-policy IID MC score estimates, averaged
